:::{#def-non-decreasing}
#### Non-decreasing sequence

A [sequence](sets-functions.qmd#def-sequence) $a_1, a_2, \ldots$
of real numbers or of [extended non-negative reals](sets-functions.qmd#def-extended-nonneg-reals)
is **non-decreasing**
if each term is at least as large as the one before it:

$$a_n \le a_{n+1} \quad \text{for every } n \in \mathbb{N}$$

:::
